description: A fresh-variable comprehension instance holds exactly when its defined relation on all tuples belongs to the available relation family.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.comprehensionInstance_realize.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] (D : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.RelationDomains M) (n X : ℕ)
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.Formula L)
  (hfresh : (n, X) ∉ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.freeRelation φ) (a : ℕ → M)
  (r : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.RelationAssignment M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.realize D a r
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.comprehensionInstance n X φ) ↔
    ∃ R ∈ D n,
      ∀ (xs : Fin n → M),
        R xs ↔
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.realize D
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fill n a xs) r φ
